scope: Full fresh candidate generation, preprocessing, encoding, native prediction, scoring and selection from causal RGB/proprio buffers; all methods CPU with2 PyTorch and2 BLAS threads. Native DINO single-candidate FP32 and LeWM native CPU; no Jacobian in any method. Fixed common nonWM polynomial bank and existing calibrated verifier thresholds, no model/threshold retraining. Randomized method/repetition order within state; fixed warmup excluded. Excludes frame acquisition/rendering, disk IO, model initialization and physical evaluation. Shared host timing, not hardware-independent bound. Strict parent action match required before any existing dense physics reuse; actual CPU-score choices may differ from former GPU LeWM choices and are evaluated separately. No latency-injected physics and no new-family final test claimed.
